tasks.title: Create authentic Code-Glider fork

tasks.title: Commit plan, audit and backlog on dedicated branch

tasks.title: Establish cloud baseline and no-secret fixture runner

tasks.title: Triage qz open PRs #15 #16 #17 and issues #8 #18
tasks.accept: Each applicable fix reproduced, reviewed and tested independently; no blind PR merge; Firefox coverage explicitly scoped

tasks.title: Create simple external trace adapter with synthetic events

tasks.title: Compile and replay smallest read-only workflow using existing qz tools

tasks.title: Declare Teach Mode capability and narrow SDK contracts
tasks.accept: Static contribution discovery passes; no cross-runtime or permissions escape

tasks.title: Create versioned raw event and normalized TraceV1 schemas
tasks.accept: Strict parse, migration and lossless redacted raw→derived origin mapping tests

tasks.title: Implement isolated content event listeners and teardown
tasks.accept: User-generated click/fill/press/select/nav/scroll captured; no duplicate listeners on resume or restart

tasks.title: Implement redaction before persistence, transport and model input

tasks.title: Implement robust target evidence and frame identity
tasks.accept: Semantic labels, CSS escaping, frame/OOPIF/shadow identity tested; mismatches abstain

tasks.title: Reduce raw events to state→action→result trace
tasks.accept: Submit/reset/image clicks and rich-text newlines preserved; redirects/typing coalesced with origin mapping

tasks.title: Add session-bound chunked trace store and cancellation barriers
tasks.accept: Bounded memory/bytes, terminal incomplete state, no writes after revoked lease and restart recovery tests

tasks.title: Add visible Start/Pause/Stop/Review UI and permission scope
tasks.accept: User sees capture scope; no implicit recording; stop/abort disposes listeners; light/dark UI smoke

tasks.title: Run Chrome recorder regression suite
tasks.accept: All relevant UPSTREAM_AUDIT P0/P1 recorder fixtures pass three clean seeded runs

tasks.title: Define strictly validated WorkflowV1 typed IR and migrations
tasks.accept: Unknown operations rejected; stable error codes; migration round-trip; deterministic hash

tasks.title: Implement parameter extraction and provenance constraints
tasks.accept: Typed inputs limited to reviewed fields; hostile page text cannot override operator inputs

tasks.title: Compile one demonstration to straight-line workflow
tasks.accept: Provider-independent prompt/structured parser; no false loops/branches from one sample; unsupported steps flagged

tasks.title: Add human step/variable/tool review and immutable approvals
tasks.accept: No generated tool or domain pattern can exceed approved scope, even through wildcard narrowing

tasks.title: Add compiler version, trace provenance and round-trip tests

tasks.title: Implement typed interpreter using existing qz browser runner
tasks.accept: No arbitrary generated JS; known commands only; zero model calls healthy path

tasks.title: Implement role/name/context locator ranking and uniqueness
tasks.accept: Duplicate labels and dynamic DOM either resolve exact intended element or abstain

tasks.title: Implement frame/OOPIF, tab ownership and navigation handling
tasks.accept: Child-frame keyboard stays in child frame; no stale document action; popup/tab rights enforced

tasks.title: Implement action deadlines, settle predicates, AbortSignal and lease checks
tasks.accept: Stop revokes writes; no zombie actions; non-idempotent writes never blindly retried

tasks.title: Prove deterministic replay across dynamic synthetic sites
tasks.accept: Every fixture has explicit verified or abstained outcome; model calls zero on healthy runs

tasks.title: Define verifier contract and typed step receipts

tasks.title: Verify file downloads and synthetic record changes independently

tasks.title: Model uncertain commits and idempotent safe resume

tasks.title: Implement model-assisted repair as candidate revision

tasks.title: Run adversarial verification and security fault campaign
